reviews.title: Quiet and Cool
reviews.comment: I bought these to go in my NZXT H9 Flow case and replace the stock case fans (3wire) with these PWM 4 wire fans, they offer superior control over the normal 3 pin.  This keeps my case cool and quiet with the proper tune.  I do near hear any rubbing or vibration from these so they should be well balanced. Use the Qtuning in the BIOS or any smart fan control that is available and switch the fans to PWM in the bios to properly use these.  My temps are low on high end stuff and fan speeds stay minimal.  Absolutely functions perfect in my case and settings. Keys to quiet: Bigger fans offer more flow at lower RPM = lower noise.  More fans = more flow allowing lower RPM of all fans.  A bigger case is usually better at cooling, a 9-10 fan case will not be noisy if tuned and built properly.
reviews.author: Ben
